signal: Aware was acquired by Mimecast and folded into its Human Risk Management platform

email.body1:
Candice, saw Aware was folded into Mimecast's Human Risk Management platform.

An integration like that usually surfaces more in-market accounts than the team can act on, and signal-to-action latency is where pipeline quietly leaks. Our AI SDR turns a buying signal into a researched, personalized, followed-up touch with zero human time per prospect: 3-5x more meetings per rep, no new hires.

I built a personalized signal play for Aware off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Candice, quick follow-up for Aware.

Most RevOps teams sit on strong intent and technographic data, but the manual research-write-log loop means signals decay before a rep acts. Tightening that into reviewed, auto-logged outreach is usually where measurable lift hides.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three changes I'd make. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
Candice, last bit of proof for Aware.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Aware's reply rate likely compares to other security-software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Candice, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If tightening signal-to-action isn't a priority during the Mimecast integration, no problem at all. Timing matters, and an integration quarter is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a RevOps motion? I'll tailor it to Aware either way.
